notes:
### 1. Individual Income Tax Rate(s) and Brackets
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026** (no rate or bracket changes between them).
* **Brackets and Rates:**
  * **Not over $10,000:** 4% of taxable income
  * **Over $10,000 but not over $40,000:** $400, plus 6% of the excess over $10,000
  * **Over $40,000 but not over $60,000:** $2,200, plus 6.5% of the excess over $40,000
  * **Over $60,000 but not over $250,000:** $3,500, plus 8.5% of the excess over $60,000
  * **Over $250,000 but not over $500,000:** $19,650, plus 9.25% of the excess over $250,000
  * **Over $500,000 but not over $1,000,000:** $42,775, plus 9.75% of the excess above $500,000
  * **Over $1,000,000:** $91,525, plus 10.75% of the excess above $1,000,000
* **Official URL:** https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/dc-individual-and-fiduciary-income-tax-rates

---

### 2. Corporate Income / Franchise Tax Rate(s) and Minimum Tax
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026** (unchanged).
* **Rates:**
  * **Corporation Franchise Tax:** 8.25% on net income of corporations in the District on a combined reporting basis.
  * **Unincorporated Business Franchise Tax:** 8.25% on net income on a combined reporting basis (with gross receipts over $12,000, after a 30% salary allowance and $5,000 exemption).
* **Minimum Tax:**
  * **$250 minimum tax** if DC gross receipts are $1 million or less.
  * **$1,000 minimum tax** if DC gross receipts are greater than $1 million (payable even if the entity has a loss).
* **Official URL:** https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/dc-business-franchise-tax-rates

---

### 3. Sales and Use Tax Rate and Local Jurisdictions
* **Tax Years:** Applies to both **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026**.
* **General Rate:**
  * The general sales and use tax rate is **6.0%** on gross receipts from sales of or charges for tangible personal property, digital goods, and taxable services.
  * *Note on scheduled increase:* The planned increase to 7.0% has been postponed; the general sales tax rate remains 6% through September 30, 2027.
* **Local Additions:** The District of Columbia is a single, unified taxing jurisdiction; there are no separate city or county local jurisdictions, and no local sales taxes are added.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/sales-use-tax
  * https://cfo.dc.gov/page/tax-rates-and-revenues-sales-and-use-taxes-alcoholic-beverage-taxes-and-tobacco-taxes

---

### 4. Gross Receipts, Franchise, Margin, or Other Notable Business Taxes
* **Tax Years:** Applies to **Tax Year 2025** and **Tax Year 2026**.
* **Notable Taxes:**
  * **Gross Receipts Tax:** Imposed on gross revenue received by specific industries for services and deliveries in the District (monthly Form FR-27 series filers), including:
    * Providers of Cable Television, Satellite Relay, or Distribution of video/radio transmissions (Form FR-27C)
    * Commercial Mobile Service Providers (Form FR-27M)
    * Electricity Providers (Form FR-27E)
    * Heating Oil Providers (Form FR-27H)
    * Natural Gas Utilities (Form FR-27NU)
    * Telephone Providers for local calls (Form FR-27U)
    * Toll Telecommunication Service Providers (Form FR-27T)
  * **Sports Facilities Fee (formerly Ballpark Fee):** Renamed to the *Sports Facilities Fee* effective October 1, 2025. Imposed annually (Form FR-1500) on businesses with $5,000,000 or more in annual DC gross receipts that are subject to DC franchise taxes or DC unemployment compensation:
    * Gross receipts $5,000,000.00 to $8,000,000.00: **$5,500.00**
    * Gross receipts $8,000,001.00 to $12,000,000.00: **$10,800.00**
    * Gross receipts $12,000,001.00 to $16,000,000.00: **$14,000.00**
    * Gross receipts $16,000,001.00 and greater: **$16,500.00**
* **Official URLs:**
  * Gross Receipts Tax: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/gross-receipts-tax
  * Sports Facilities Fee: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/page/sports-facilities-fee
  * Notice of October 1, 2025 Tax Changes: https://otr.cfo.dc.gov/release/notice-oct-1-2025-tax-changes

proposals.value: DC imposes gross receipts taxes on specific industries such as utilities and telecommunications providers. Additionally, businesses with $5,000,000 or more in annual DC gross receipts pay an annual Sports Facilities Fee ranging from $5,500.00 to $16,500.00.
proposals.snippet: What tax form must be filed? FR-1500 Who Must File? The entities subject to the Sports Facilities Fee (“feepayers”) are businesses that have income of $5,000,000.00 or more in annual District gross receipts and either are subject to filing franchise tax returns (whether Corporate or Unincorporated) or are employers required to make unemployment insurance contributions.
